text: も　もう　おしえて　やったから　おれら　かえるぜ！

structure.jp: も　もう　おしえて　やったから

patterns.name: 〜てやる
patterns.explanation: やる after a て-form verb means doing something for someone, said from above in a rough way. おしえて　やった = 'we did you the favor of telling you'.

patterns.name: 〜から
patterns.explanation: から after a statement gives the reason, like 'so'. おしえて　やったから = 'we told you, so'.

patterns.name: 〜ぜ
patterns.explanation: ぜ at the end is rough, masculine emphasis. かえるぜ = 'we're leaving!'
